CLIENT — "What is happening with my image production?"
Account strip (credits/trial/currency) → Active production (precise status, real-style thumbnails, honest due-date-or-none) → Ready to download → Recent orders log. Billing/specs/support are honest links, not fabricated working widgets — billing and support have no built dashboard experience yet.

ADMIN — "What requires my operational attention?"
Unassigned queue leads, then status-breakdown counts, revisions, deliveries, workload and customer activity. The dashed "Insights" panel is deliberate: it names what's NOT built (SLA tracking, trend analytics) instead of faking it — no computed at-risk indicator or approval score anywhere on this screen.
